### Jehoshaphat’s Successes
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/jehoshaphats-successes
Passage: 2 Chronicles 17:5-6
Points:
- Jehoshaphat followed David’s faithful example by walking in God’s commandments and purging idolatry from Judah.
- The Lord established his kingdom and granted him substantial wealth, honor, and security in response to his obedience.
- Jehoshaphat placed high priority on spiritual education by dispatching leaders and Levites to instruct the people in God's Law.
- God’s people today must seek leaders who fear the Lord, honor justice, and remain devoted to His truth.
- Believers must exercise wisdom and refuse to compromise core biblical truth for the sake of unholy alliances.
